testing_summary: 6 new unit tests and 1 new e2e test were inspected to validate the bounded registration deadline, abort-on-timeout, caller-cancel, and recovery behaviors. No tests were executed per review phase gate.
risk_rationale: The change implements a well-bounded 10-second registration ceiling with AbortController-backed cancellation across service-worker readiness, subscription work, and token registration. All code paths (timeout, parent signal abort, component unmount, successful registration) are handled with proper cleanup via scope.dispose() in finally blocks. No unintended side effects or reachable disclosures detected.
